text: In all courts you must expect to meet with connections without friendship, enmities without hatred, honor without virtue, appearances saved, and realities sacrificed; good manners with bad morals; and all vice and virtues so disguised, that whoever has only reasoned upon both would know neither when he first met them at court.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CXVI, to his son, London, June 11, Old Style 1750
